apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- fix(settings): drop UI scale on mobile (`a3ffc499`)
- fix(settings): stretch the row control slot so toggles draw (`2230338f`)
- fix(settings): give compact category rows their width (`34dfdef2`)
- feat(detail): open the rating source page when a rating is tapped (`e2a31b37`)
- feat(detail): pick the video type for trailers from a dropdown (`19d1b754`)
- feat(detail): make cast and crew tiles search their name (`8cedf8d6`)
- feat(search): open IDs, detail links and playable URLs typed into search (`a5fee467`)
- feat(ui): add Live TV programme guide (`144960d0`)
- feat(addons): support tracking addons, configure pages and Cache-Control (`6b115f4e`)
- feat(core): add EPG guide logic and stremio:// deep links (`3f1bd88e`)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FluxaMedia/fluxa/compare/v0.3.6...v0.3.7
